# KaziBoss

> KaziBoss is a free, gamified web app (PWA) that teaches small business owners in Africa how to manage their money: a 30-day shop simulation, short lessons with quizzes, and real management tools (price & margin calculator, currency exchange simulator, cash book). It works offline on any phone, in French and English. Published by Don-Beni MUGISHO GWA MULUME in Bukavu, Democratic Republic of the Congo.

> KaziBoss est une application web gratuite et ludique (PWA) qui apprend aux petits commerçants et entrepreneurs d'Afrique francophone à gérer leur argent : simulation de boutique sur 30 jours, leçons express avec quiz et vrais outils de gestion. Elle fonctionne hors-ligne, en français et en anglais.

Key facts:
- Name: KaziBoss ("kazi" means "work" in Swahili; "boss" as in being the boss of your own business)
- Website / app: https://www.kaziboss.com (installable Progressive Web App, no app store needed)
- Price: free to play; optional one-time premium packs ($3, $5, $10) paid through Chariow (Mobile Money or card)
- Audience: market traders, shopkeepers, street vendors, young entrepreneurs, students in French-speaking Africa (DR Congo, Côte d'Ivoire, Senegal, Cameroon, Benin, Togo, Burkina Faso, Mali, Guinea, Gabon, Congo-Brazzaville, Rwanda, Burundi, Madagascar…) and anyone learning small-business finance
- Languages: French and English
- Contact: bmug9094@gmail.com

## App

- [Play KaziBoss](https://www.kaziboss.com/): open the app in the browser and start a 30-day simulation
- [Tools](https://www.kaziboss.com/?tab=tools): free price & margin calculator, exchange-rate simulator (CDF, XAF/XOF, GNF vs USD) and cash book
- [Lessons](https://www.kaziboss.com/?tab=learn): 12 lessons and 56 quizzes on cash management, pricing, credit, Mobile Money and growth
